name: Loi'kru
description: Melee hero who transforms between a shielding Earth form and Healing water form.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.description:
Shoots a burst of water at a target unit, dealing {Damage} damage and knocking it back.
If cast on an allied unit, heals instead of damages.

abilities.name: Healing Wave
abilities.description: Create a wave in a target direction, knocking back enemies, and healing allies for {health} health.

abilities.name: Earth Shield
abilities.description:
Give the target unit a shield which absorbs up to {absorbdamage} damage.
Shield deals {damage} damage to nearby enemies when broken.
Lasts {duration} seconds.

abilities.name: Boulder
abilities.description:
Gather nearby allies and roll towards a target direction.
Stops upon impact with an enemy unit, stunning the struck unit for {stunduration} seconds and dealing {damage} damage.

abilities.name: Transform
abilities.description:
Transforms between Earth and Water forms with different abiltiies.
Earth form has +{armor} armor.
Water form has +{regen} health regeneration.
